name: Leonardo247
positioning: Portfolio-wide operations and risk platform for property owners, covering due diligence, maintenance and student housing turns.
description: Leonardo247 is a suite of modules for multifamily and student housing operators: Acquire247 runs unit-by-unit due diligence inspections before acquisition, Perform247 manages day-to-day maintenance workflows, inspections and code compliance, Protect247 runs preventative-maintenance risk workflows, Connect247 covers remote maintenance dispatch, and Student247 manages student-housing turn logistics such as key returns and vendor scheduling.
real_estate_use: An operations manager overseeing a multifamily portfolio needs a single system to run acquisition due diligence, then keep every property compliant on preventative maintenance and inspections once it's owned — a missed fire-code inspection or a botched student-housing turn creates both risk and cost. Leonardo247 gives the team one platform across the acquisition-to-operations lifecycle instead of separate spreadsheets per phase.

use_cases.job: Run unit-by-unit due diligence inspections ahead of a multifamily acquisition
Track preventative maintenance and code-compliance inspections across a portfolio
